customer_problem: Operators assemble site briefs by hand from shared drives and chat threads. The same question can surface material a given role should not see, and the assistant is simply unavailable when a site network link is down. The intake asks for a scoped four-week pilot, not a company-wide rollout. This package uses only fictional, unclassified assumptions about Northbridge Logistics.

sow.title: Role-restricted operations assistant — four-week pilot
sow.problem: Stand up a pilot assistant that drafts operations briefs for a fictional logistics company, respects role-based access, keeps sensitive fields out of the model context, and continues to run inside a private network when public egress is blocked.
users: Site operations lead (drafts and reviews briefs)
constraints: Document-level access control at retrieval time
No public internet egress from the pilot VPC
High-stakes actions (share with a partner, or open a ticket) require a recorded human approval

goals: Lock the data model, roles, and fixture corpus
Stand up retrieval with document ACLs

deliverables: Tokenize-and-restore path with an audit log

goals: Pause high-stakes tool calls for human approval
Prove the workflow survives a restart
Deploy into a private VPC with no public egress
Measure the pilot against the success metrics

out_of_scope: Live production data or real customer records
Company-wide rollout beyond the first operations-center cohort
Production identity federation (stub identity is enough for the pilot)

pilot_plan.baseline: Briefs are assembled manually from shared drives. Role-based access is informal. There is no assistant when a site link is down, and outbound partner shares have no recorded approval.
success_measures: Zero unauthorized document hits on the fixture ACL tests
All planted sensitive spans are tokenized before inference
An in-flight approval still waits after a worker restart
Egress smoke test shows no public internet path from the pilot VPC
pilot_plan.first_shippable_slice: ACL-filtered retrieval, a sensitive-field proxy, one approval-gated action, and a private-VPC deploy on the fictional fixture set.

threat_model.summary: The pilot's main risks are identity confusion, prompt or corpus tampering, unlogged shares, leakage across role boundaries, a hard dependency on a single model endpoint, and an agent expanding its own privileges.

items.threat: A user or agent presents itself as a more privileged role and retrieves the wrong corpus.
items.mitigation: Authenticate at the edge, bind every request to a role, and enforce ACLs in the retriever, not the prompt.

items.threat: Fixture documents or prompts are modified to exfiltrate another role's context.
items.mitigation: Version and hash the corpus, restrict who can edit prompts, and review retrieval traces.

items.threat: A share or ticket is issued and later denied because there is no durable record.
items.mitigation: Immutable audit log plus a workflow history for every high-stakes action.

items.threat: Sensitive spans or unauthorized documents reach the model or another user.
items.mitigation: Document-level access control, pre-inference tokenization, and no public egress from the VPC.

items.threat: The assistant becomes unusable if a cloud endpoint is unreachable — the original customer complaint.
items.mitigation: Keep inference and stores inside the private VPC; fail closed on egress; test a blocked-internet path.

items.threat: The agent calls a write or share tool it was not granted, or expands its own scopes.
items.mitigation: Short-lived task-bound credentials, allowlisted tools, and a human approval gate on restricted actions.

architecture.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Officer[Site operations lead] --> UI[Ops UI]
  UI --> API[Pilot API]
  API --> ACL[Document ACL]
  API --> Proxy[Sensitive-field proxy]
  ACL --> RAG[Secure retriever]
  Proxy --> RAG
  RAG --> Store[Vector store]
  Proxy --> LLM[Model in private VPC]
  API --> Gate[Approval workflow]
  Gate --> Approver[Human approver]
  API --> Audit[Audit and traces]
  VPC[Google Cloud private VPC, no public egress] -.-> API
architecture.caption: Pilot request path inside a Google Cloud private VPC: authorize, tokenize, retrieve only authorized chunks, infer with no public egress, and pause restricted actions for a human.

success_metrics.name: Unauthorized retrieval rate
success_metrics.baseline: Not measured; shared-drive access is informal
success_metrics.target: 0 hits on the fixture ACL suite

success_metrics.name: Sensitive-span handling
success_metrics.baseline: Raw fields can be pasted into a chat tool
success_metrics.target: 100% of planted spans tokenized before infer
success_metrics.how_measured: Proxy audit log vs. planted fixture values

success_metrics.name: Approval durability
success_metrics.baseline: No recorded approval for outbound partner shares
success_metrics.target: In-flight approvals resume after a forced worker restart
success_metrics.how_measured: Chaos step in the demo script

success_metrics.name: Egress posture
success_metrics.target: No public egress from the pilot VPC
